mapper.select: SELECT t1.test_answer_id, t2.test_name, t3.subject_name, t4.video_url, t4.cover_url, t4.video_id, t4.video_name FROM ms_test_answer AS t1 JOIN ms_test AS t2 ON t1.test_id = t2.test_id AND t2.test_type = 4 LEFT JOIN ms_subjects AS t3 ON t3.subject_id = t2.subject_id LEFT JOIN ms_video AS t4 ON t4.test_id = t1.test_id AND t4.del_flag=0 WHERE t1.`status` = 2 AND t1.user_id = #{userId} AND t1.del_flag = 0

SELECT t2.test_name, t2.start_time, t1.sum_score, t3.subject_name, t2.question_num, t1.`status`, t2.deadline, t2.suggest_duration, t1.test_answer_id FROM ms_test_answer AS t1 JOIN ms_test AS t2 ON t1.test_id = t2.test_id AND t2.test_type != 4 JOIN ms_subjects AS t3 ON t2.subject_id = t3.subject_id WHERE t1.user_id = #{userId} AND t1.`status` = 2 AND t1.del_flag = 0

SELECT t1.test_answer_id, t1.test_name, t1.submit_time, t1.`status`, t1.sum_score, t1.create_time, t1.duration, COUNT(t3.question_answer_id) AS question_num, COUNT(IF(t3.`status`=1,1,0)) AS right_num, COUNT(IF(t3.question_type IN(3,4,5),1,0)) AS auto_checking, IF(t1.`status`=1,t1.user_test_score,NULL) AS final_score, t4.subject_name, IFNULL( t2.test_type, 6 ) AS test_type FROM ms_test_answer AS t1 LEFT JOIN ms_test AS t2 ON t1.test_id = t2.test_id LEFT JOIN ms_question_answer AS t3 ON t3.test_answer_id = t1.test_answer_id AND t3.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN ms_subjects AS t4 ON t3.subject_id = t4.subject_id
t1.user_id = #{userId} AND t1.del_flag = 0
AND t4.subject_id=#{subjectId}
GROUP BY t1.test_answer_id ORDER BY t1.submit_time DESC

select task.task_name, ta.test_answer_id, ta.test_name, u.nick_name, ta.sum_score, ta.duration, ta.user_test_score, qa.question_answer_id, qa.question_title, qa.question_difficulty, qa.user_answer, qa.explain, qa.`status`, qa.right_answer, qa.question_score, qa.option, qa.question_type from ms_test_answer ta left join ms_question_answer qa on ta.test_answer_id=qa.test_answer_id left join ms_task_test tt on ta.test_id=tt.test_id and tt.del_flag='0' left join ms_task task on tt.task_id=task.task_id left join sys_user u on ta.user_id=u.user_id where ta.test_answer_id=#{testAnswerId} and ta.del_flag='0' and ta.status=0
